card.name: Words after remove or withdraw steps
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the' or 'and', or the verb itself, right after an instruction to remove, withdraw or lift an item in step-by-step directions. It also fires on the object just taken away, such as a syringe.

modes.label: After remove or withdraw
modes.description: The word 'the' follows a verb such as withdraw or remove, before the item being taken out.
modes.example: Withdraw<< the>> contents of the cup into

modes.label: Next action in a step
modes.description: A verb or linking word starts the next action after an item is taken out or moved.
modes.example: Withdraw the needle<< and>> allow protective sleeve to slide and cover needle

modes.label: Item just removed
modes.description: The end of the object being removed, such as a syringe, comes just after a remove instruction.
modes.example: remove the sy<<ringe>> and immediately thoroughly mix the final infusion solution
